title: Squared convolution expectation identity
statement:
For every integer $n \ge 0$, let $\phi$ and $\psi$ be probability densities on the Boolean cube $\mathbb{F}_2^n$, and let $F:\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\mathbb{R}$. Then
\[
\mathbb{E}_{z\sim\psi}\!\left[(\phi*F)(z)^2\right]
=\mathbb{E}_{y\sim\phi}\,\mathbb{E}_{y'\sim\phi}\,\mathbb{E}_{z\sim\psi}\!\left[F(z+y)F(z+y')\right],
\]
where each expectation is weighted by the indicated density and addition is coordinatewise modulo $2$.
